Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer misreported information from the GOV.UK site, stating that David Lloyd George was born in Llanystumdwy, Caernarvonshire instead of Manchester. This resulted in conflicting information that was then compounded by successive attempts to retrieve reliable sources, leading to further errors not being corrected effectively. This mistake arises due to a failure in synthesizing information accurately during the extraction process, and it was exacerbated by focusing on non-authoritative snippets without resolving discrepancies effectively.
